summary_en: 3,405,888 shares to be cancelled on 2026-07-31. Represents 6.30% of shares outstanding pre-cancellation. Post-cancellation share count: 50,695,447.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-21, the board of directors of Quants Research Institute Holdings resolved to cancel 3,405,888 treasury shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation represents 6.30% of shares outstanding immediately prior to cancellation and encompasses all treasury shares held by the company as of the resolution date. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 2026-07-31, resulting in a post-cancellation issued share count of 50,695,447.
